description: This file contains functions for interacting with IndexedDB to perform CRUD operations on invoice data, including inserting, retrieving, and updating invoices.

methods.name: forceInsertInvoice
methods.description: Inserts or overrides an invoice in the IndexedDB, generating a new UUID for the invoice.

methods.name: getAllInvoices
methods.description: Retrieves all invoices from the IndexedDB.

methods.name: getInvoiceById
methods.description: Fetches a specific invoice by its ID from the IndexedDB.

methods.name: updateInvoice
methods.description: Updates an existing invoice in the IndexedDB, replacing the old record.
